title: Winter Acoustic Sessions at Portsea Hotel
summary: Local musicians every Friday and Saturday throughout winter at Portsea Hotel. Laid-back evenings with live tunes, food and drinks by the coast.
recurrenceNote: Every Friday and Saturday evening during winter from 6pm
suitableFor: Adults, couples, groups, locals and visitors
accessibilityNotes: Hotel accessible; contact venue for specific needs
nearbyAttractions: Portsea back beach; Point Nepean National Park; Portsea front beach
suggestedItineraryPairing: Walk Point Nepean in the afternoon, then settle in for the acoustic session and dinner at the hotel
editorVerdict: The most atmospheric winter Friday-Saturday on the whole Peninsula. The combination of Portsea in winter, fire, live music and cold beer is hard to beat.
editorNote:
Portsea Hotel runs local acoustic acts every Friday and Saturday for the whole winter season - no ticket, no booking, just show up from 6pm. The hotel is right at the tip of the Peninsula so you get that end-of-the-road feeling with it.

Best move: afternoon walk at Point Nepean or out to the back beach, then into the hotel as the sun drops. Fires on, musicians set up, order food and stay as long as you like.

No charge to get in. Dinner from the kitchen. Pair with a coastal walk the next morning before the drive home.
